description: Source file for input utilities in Zephyr OS, including input event handling, shell commands for input reporting, dumping, and keyboard matrix state logging.

methods.name: input_dump_enabled
methods.description: Checks if input dump is enabled, either via atomic variable or always true depending on configuration.

methods.name: input_cmd_dump
methods.description: Shell command to enable or disable input event dumping.

methods.name: input_cb
methods.description: Callback function invoked on input events, logs event details if dumping is enabled.

methods.name: input_cmd_report
methods.description: Shell command to trigger an input report event with specified type, code, value, and sync flag.

methods.name: kbd_matrix_state_log_entry
methods.description: Logs the current state of the keyboard matrix.

methods.name: kbd_matrix_state_log
methods.description: Logs keyboard matrix state changes based on input events.

methods.name: input_cmd_kbd_matrix_state_dump
methods.description: Shell command to enable or disable keyboard matrix state logging for a device.

methods.name: device_name_get
methods.description: Retrieves device name for shell command sub-entries.
